metadata.question: Was the rainfall in Seattle between September through November in 2021 larger than that in 2020 and in 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Location: Seattle, WA (approx. 47.6°N, 122.3°W) - Dates: * 2021: September 1 - November 30, 2021 * 2020: September 1 - November 30, 2020 * 2019: September 1 - November 30, 2019 - Collection: NOAA/PERSIANN-CDR for daily precipitation (alternative: NASA/GLDAS precipitation) 2. Masking Strategy: - No cloud masking needed; precipitation data is gridded and not affected by clouds in the same way as optical imagery. 3. Logic: - Sum total precipitation for each year (Sep-Nov). - Compare 2021 vs 2020 and 2021 vs 2019. - Valid Zero: A result of 0mm is valid (though unlikely for Seattle in fall). - Null/Error: If no data exists for any year, return C1. If valid pixels = 0, return C2. If result is NaN or invalid, return C3. - Answer: A (Yes) if 2021 > 2020 AND 2021 > 2019. B (No) otherwise. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Seattle geometry const seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.33, 47.61]); const buffer = seattle.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer to ensure coverage // Define date ranges for Sep-Nov const dates = { 2019: { start: '2019-09-01', end: '2019-11-30' }, 2020: { start: '2020-09-01', end: '2020-11-30' }, 2021: { start: '2021-09-01', end: '2021-11-30' } }; // Function to calculate total precipitation async function getPrecipitation(year) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/PERSIANN-CDR') .filterDate(dates[year].start, dates[year].end) .filterBounds(buffer); const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { console.log(`${year}: No data found.`); return null; } // Sum all daily precipitation const totalPrecip = col.select('precipitation').sum(); // Calculate mean over the buffer region const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const precipValue = stats['precipitation']; // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count = pixelCount['precipitation']; console.log(`${year}: Images=${size}, Precip=${precipValue !== null ? precipValue.toFixed(1) : 'null'}mm, ValidPixels=${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log(`${year}: No valid pixels after processing.`); return null; } if (precipValue === null || isNaN(precipValue)) { console.log(`${year}: Invalid precipitation value.`); return null; } return precipValue; } // Get precipitation for all three years const precip2019 = await getPrecipitation(2019); const precip2020 = await getPrecipitation(2020); const precip2021 = await getPrecipitation(2021); // Validate results if (precip2019 === null || precip2020 === null || precip2021 === null) { console.log('Result: C1'); return; } // Check if 2021 is larger than both 2020 and 2019 const is2021Larger = (precip2021 > precip2020) && (precip2021 > precip2019); console.log(`Summary: 2019=${precip2019.toFixed(1)}mm, 2020=${precip2020.toFixed(1)}mm, 2021=${precip2021.toFixed(1)}mm`); if (is2021Larger) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
